== ''Guild Wars'' Wiki: Terms of Use ==
The Official ''Guild Wars'' Wiki is an online, public collaboration of information centering around [http://www.arena.net/ ArenaNet]'s competitive online roleplaying game, [http://guildwars.com/ Guild Wars]. All information contained on this website is provided by the voluntary efforts of individual players and groups working to develop a comprehensive information resource for all ''[[Guild Wars]]'' fans to use and enjoy.  “ArenaNet”, as used in these Terms of Use, means ArenaNet, LLC. and its successors and assigns.

Please note that articles and information found within this wiki have not necessarily been reviewed by members of the ''[[Guild Wars]]'' development team, employees of ArenaNet, or employees of NCSOFT Corporation (“NCSOFT”).

=== No Formal Developer Reviews ===
While members of the ''Guild Wars'' development team can and do access the Official ''Guild Wars'' Wiki, it should be understood that all articles cannot be officially reviewed at all times. Our community of editors use resources such as the Special:Recentchanges and Special:Newpages feeds to monitor new and changing content.
